# ProRes bits per macroblock<AvailableFrom v="4.0.543" />

Set the bit budget per macroblock for software ProRes encoding. Accepts an integer from 128 to 8192. Lower values can reduce file size and quality; higher values may produce the same output depending on the content and ProRes profile. Default: `null`, which lets the encoder choose based on the profile. This maps to FFmpeg's `-bits_per_mb` option for `prores_ks` and requires the `prores` codec. With `hardwareAcceleration` set to `if-possible`, encoding falls back to software; `required` is not supported. The ProRes profile and pixel format still determine the output format and alpha channel support.

## CLI flag

```text
--prores-bits-per-macroblock <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)
- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)
- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)
- [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#proresbitspermacroblock)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#proresbitspermacroblock)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#proresbitspermacroblock)

